actual: 2026-07-13 production SIM run simrun_7e0ac11328470378 has qmt batch SUBMITTING with 13 submitted, 16 pending, 0 failed and 29 ACTIVE algos. Broker-authoritative reconciliation reports 91 UNBACKED_STRATEGY_POSITION warnings and submit_result_gate=blocked, which rewrites the run to FAILED_RETRYABLE. _should_drive_existing_miniqmt_event_loop accepts only SUBMITTING or INTRADAY_RUNNING, so the 16 valid pending algos stop receiving scheduler ticks. Preserve loud broker reconciliation and capping, but keep the durable event-loop runtime INTRADAY_RUNNING while pending algos exist; do not duplicate orders, silently fallback, weaken broker authority, or add approval gates.
